clock.why: USB needs a 48 MHz clock the F103 can only make from an external crystal (RM0008 §7.2.3); the Arduino core's clock setup for this chip starts the 8 MHz HSE

board.reason: needs an 8 MHz HSE crystal and its load capacitors; the board generator does not place crystals yet (docs/mcu.md, Not done)

currents.source: DocID13587 Rev 16 (STM32F103x8/xB): run 72 MHz, external clock, peripherals off 27 mA typ (Table 17); Stop with the regulator in low-power mode 14 µA, the mode the firmware sleeps in (Standby 3.2 µA loses RAM, Table 16). No minimum supply current stated; 50 mA is Bringup's margin

history.source: STM32duino EEPROM emulation: one 1 KB flash page (F103 medium density, RM0008 §3.3.3)

sim.note: Renode stm32f103.repl: no SPI or ADC model

sources: DocID13587 Rev 16: Fig. 14 power supply scheme (5 × 100 nF + 4.7 µF on VDD3; VDDA 10 nF + 1 µF, here 100 nF), Fig. 31 NRST 0.1 µF, §2.3.8 boot modes, Fig. 2 note 2 (USB needs the HSE and PLL)
